round1_followup.major_1_topology_of_D_Mtilde: RESOLVED. GX.btzRangeTop is a genuinely independent rendering of defi:BTZtop (l.2281) traced on D(M̃): induced(val) ⊓ generateFrom {val⁻¹(I⁺(Dx) ∪ Δₓ) : x BTZ}. In Mathlib's order, ⊓ means the topology generated by both families, which is the right direction, and the same shape GX.devImageTop uses. Δₓ = D(sing M̃) ∩ J⁺(Dx) ∖ {Dx} equals {Dx + λu, λ>0} by the hray conjunct, so Δₓ is the paper's ]p,+∞[. GX.BTZTildeData.btzRangeTop_eq_devImageTop proves the equality with devImageTop, which is the proof's l.2390–2395. Its two hypotheses are injectivity and hray, and both are derived inside btz_uniformization_btzRays, not assumed. Generators at a ray's open endpoint a ∉ D(M̃) are not missing: every point of ]a,+∞[ has a BTZ point below it on the ray (btzTilde_exists_sing_below), so I⁺(a) ∪ ]a,+∞[ is a union of the file's generators and I⁺(a). The headline now states the equality and the homeomorphism with `letI := btzRangeTop`, so the last bullet is about the BTZ topology of a subset of 𝐌³, as the paper requires.

issues.problem: This is now the ONLY thing keeping the headline row partial, and its stated justification is wrong. The file proves a homeomorphism h : ρ(Γ)\D(M̃) ≃ₜ M with D(M̃) in btzRangeTop. It adds the conjunct btzTilde_quotient_compat, which follows from h[De] = e.base and f∘proj = π∘D and gives no structure on ρ\D(M̃). The REPORT says nothing stronger can be stated without a new definition. The strict library refutes that. GX/Singular/Atlas.lean:1509 has SingularGXStructure, IsAEMorphismOf and maximalAEAtlas. GX/Singular/Quotient.lean:909 has existsUnique_aeGXQuotient (prop:aeGXquotient). And the SAME phrase has already been certified in the a.e. sense twice in this very paper. (a) prop:quotient_chart, the BTZ twin of this bullet ('D̄ : 𝔼₀ → Γ\J⁺(Δ) is an isomorphism of singular E^{1,2}-manifold', with J⁺(Δ) in the BTZ topology), is GX.btz_quotient_chart (GX/BTZ/Topology.lean:1159): a homeomorphism that is an a.e. (Isom, 𝐌³)-morphism, with its inverse an a.e. morphism too, the quotient carrying the unique structure that makes the projection an a.e. morphism. (b) rem:tamely_singular_manifold_admits is GX.tamely_singular_manifold_admits_aeIso (GX/SingularII/Tame.lean:726). There the homeomorphism Γ(N/M)\D(N) ≃ₜ M is proved an a.e. (G,X)-isomorphism for the quotient structure, characterised as the unique maximal a.e. atlas making N → Γ\D(N) an a.e. morphism, and its hypotheses are the shape this file already has: Galoisian p, injective D, holonomy ρ. DEC-87 (c)'s 'isomorphic = homeomorphic' was ruled for rem:quotient_virtually_tame only, and the headline's proof names 'isomorphism of singular E-manifolds' explicitly. So the singular-manifold half of the bullet is a missing assertion that the library makes avoidable. The dispatch's 'certify IN FULL' is therefore not met, and the ruling question as written rests on a false premise. The row is honestly partial and unmarked, so this is not an overclaim.

verified_findings: defi:BTZtop on D(M̃) is now certified in substance. btzRangeTop is generated by 𝐌³'s topology and the traces of I⁺(Dx) ∪ ]Dx,+∞[, and it is PROVED equal to the D-image topology of T_BTZ (btzRangeTop_eq_devImageTop). The headline's quotient homeomorphism is stated in btzRangeTop, which formalises the proof's step at l.2390–2395 that the round-1 audit found missing.
